scope: One bounded static pass on the existing candidate. No candidate search, dependency installation, target-code execution, solver dispatch or upstream solution/history inspection.

inputs.repo_skill: Root SKILL.md read; no prior trace/experience retrieval or script execution. Pinned target tree contains no AGENTS.md or .agents/skills instructions.

correction.previous_gate: The recovery/queue treated an observed reproducible migration failure as a mandatory readiness prerequisite.
correction.interpretation: PROTOCOL target admission requires a real major-version migration, a frozen environment/goal/dependency state, predeclared verification and a nonvacuous behavior-sensitive oracle. It does not require a pre-existing public failure signature. A failure signature is conditional evidence if observed, not a mandatory gate.
correction.history_policy: Original recovery report preserved unchanged; this additive report supersedes only its mandatory-failure interpretation. Candidate remains NEEDS_EVIDENCE for independent reasons.

scope_decision.reason: The library has its own public React component/hook API and nontrivial migration surface. Adding the independent CRA sample would add a second dependency/toolchain graph without being necessary to establish behavior-sensitive migration correctness. Rush does not include the sample and its App.test.js is vacuous.

static_evidence.finding: Source library manifests use React/react-dom ^18.0.0, while dev types are React 16 and test renderer is testing-library 11.

Pinned Rush shrinkwrap actually resolves React/react-dom 18.3.1; @types/react 16.14.62; @types/react-dom 16.9.25; RTL 11.2.7; TypeScript 4.9.5; Jest 27.5.1; ts-jest 27.1.5; API Extractor 7.52.1 (nested compiler 5.8.2). This is parsed lock metadata, not installation evidence.

useTrackMetric contains a zero-argument typed useRef call. Official React 19 guidance requires a useRef argument; this supplies concrete source-level nontrivial type-migration evidence without asserting any observed compiler failure.

Library tsconfig uses the classic React JSX transform. React 19 documentation requires the modern transform. Packaging must continue to keep React and its runtime subpaths external and preserve generated declarations.

The source-lock RTL 11.2.7 implementation calls ReactDOM.render and unmountComponentAtNode; React 19 removes those APIs. Existing HOC and boundary tests call RTL render. Thus keeping the old runner would not establish React 19 behavior.

Boundary implements fallback and exception telemetry; hook/HOC implementations implement activity timing and interval cleanup; event hook implements initial skip and effect cleanup. These directly support meaningful behavior oracles independent of a known patch.
Root postinstall invokes Rush update, which is not frozen replay. Proposed install path uses Rush install with local tools; exact pinned bootstrap/rebuild behavior still requires admitted preflight.

target_proposal.compatibility_claim: React 19 only; React 18 retained support not claimed.
target_proposal.unchanged_dependency_policy: Retain unrelated source-lock resolutions; minimally necessary transitive changes frozen and reviewed. No SDK upgrade shortcut. One React 19/type major in consumer graph; no force/legacy-peer-deps.
target_proposal.tooling_rationale: React types 19 declare TypeScript baseline 5.0. Propose compiler 5.1.6, RTL 16.1.0 and DOM 10.4.0 for React 19 peers. ts-jest 29.2.5 declares TS >=4.3 <6 and Jest ^29; align Jest/jsdom 29.7.0 and Jest/Node declarations. Avoid unrelated API Extractor/Rollup upgrades by retaining source-lock versions.
target_proposal.metadata_vs_execution: All 12 name/version entries and reported dist integrity/peer/engine metadata retrieved from official npm registry by read-only HTTP. No tarballs downloaded, integrity independently recomputed, packages installed, or tools executed.

environment_proposal.note: Historical isolated-experiment pins, not production security recommendations. Root yarn.lock does not establish npm/Rush replay. No root npm install is proposed.
environment_proposal.host_authority: Linux is a reproducibility proposal only. It does not authorize changing the user's Mac, installing virtualization/containers, or switching execution environments. Actual authorized local isolation and compatibility remain preflight; otherwise request an explicit environment decision.

coverage: full build, declarations and typed packaged consumer
React 19 real-DOM boundary fallback and exact exception payload/count
HOC and hook engagement time with exact deterministic active/idle durations
timer cleanup and no-activity negative case
event initial-skip/update and StrictMode replay semantics
runtime resolution to built local tarball; no registry/source alias escape
oracle.nonvacuity_preflight: Evaluator must implement and hash fixtures, verify a passing neutral React 19 control and intentionally broken behavior controls, ensure each focused assertion detects disabled telemetry/cleanup, and preserve results separately. These controls must not expose a solution to the solver. All currently NOT_RUN.
oracle.expectation_review: The idle/resume candidate 2-second value is derived from the pinned engagement calculation and needs timer-order validation. StrictMode event initial-skip replay counts are proposed from pinned cleanup logic, not an observed baseline or an independent deduplication requirement. Evaluator must preserve declared API/baseline semantics and review/freeze both expectations before a solver; never add new behavior merely to satisfy proposed tests.

remaining_pre_execution_checks: Reconcile actual local admission state and all receipts; no duplicate case/consumer. Manual re-trigger is required; do not auto-resume or poll.
Establish an authorized isolated environment and immutable OS/runtime/tool identities. Do not run preparation or solver work while budget remaining is UNKNOWN.

Determine remaining case/day/rolling-seven-day agent-minute balances from authoritative receipts, reserve permitted time, obey 90/120/600 ceilings and one-task/one-consumer limits. Ceilings are not balances.

Verify source revision and full source lock/blob; perform separately authorized baseline replay/check/build/test and classify setup or pre-existing failures. No need invent a migration failure signature.

Resolve only proposed target constraints using local tools in isolation; capture all target transitive metadata/integrities and freeze graph/manifest overlay. Do not create a source fix or use later target revisions.

Validate exact install/check/rebuild/test/pack command behavior with pinned Rush and project-local tools; remove placeholders, account for root dependencies if actually necessary with a separate frozen snapshot, never global install or root postinstall update.

Author evaluator fixture and scripts before the solver; freeze hashes/config/locks, prove real React19 and built local tarball resolution, test nonvacuity/mutation controls and expected baseline/target distinctions. Ordinary sample suite never substitutes.
Finalize peer policy/scope/goal and allowed file changes; handle any incompatibility with a reviewed packet revision before arms, not silent pin drift.

Complete solution-exposure ledger for historical sourcing. Current static coordinator inspected only pinned source and first-party package/docs, no upstream migration PRs/later target history. Use fresh non-inheriting A-only solver, exclude coordinator report/queue clues.
Only after all independent gates and execution authority pass may existing process change status to READY and write CLAIM. This pass creates neither.

assessment.conditional_exclusions: Reject or reassess if preflight shows only a trivial edit, no reliable behavior oracle, unresolvable lock/tooling, prohibited setup, contamination or insufficient authorized resources. Setup failure is BLOCKED, not a migration failure.
assessment.decision: Retain existing candidate NEEDS_EVIDENCE. Static goal/pin/oracle proposal is now concrete; runtime readiness is not established.
assessment.claimed_efficacy: NONE; A-only preparation cannot establish experience-transfer benefit.
